title: Hinomori Shiho — An All-Out Performance〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Let's keep doing our best, everyone...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And keep doing everything we can until our show.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, of course!
We're gonna blow that crowd away during our next show!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Hmm... The classroom I'm using today should be...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Shiho, wait...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Len? Rin, you too? What's going on?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: We thought what you said just now was so cool, Shih!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, the way you said, “But we've gotta do this,” was great.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, that was just...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (It isn't just Saki...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (They're all nervous about having to play on the same stage as anemone.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I understand how you all feel.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But we've gotta do this.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I was just trying to tell the others that we can't let things go on the way they were.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Originally, I wanted to find a way to get through to the crowd at that live house with our songs...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But I ended up picking a fight with Saku, and said that we're gonna show everyone that belittled our music just who we are with our music.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Unfortunately, as a result, that resulted in extra pressure being placed on the others.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
I see...
But Ichika would've spoken up if you hadn't, right?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! You shouldn't be feeling bad about this, Shih!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I mean, I wanna see your efforts get rewarded and tell them, “See?! Aren't these girls great!”

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Why are you the one getting all high and mighty, Rin...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Why? Because we're all friends♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Anyway, it's true that we all want you to put your best foot forward.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Unfortunately, you're the ones who have to do the work, and we can't really do much when it comes to the actual show.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Which is why it was really great to see you doing what you can to inspire everyone.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! I think they all responded really well because you're not afraid of speaking your mind!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hm...? You don't seem all that content...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh...? No, I'm just surprised is all...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I... On more than one occasion, I made the mistake of speaking too harshly or going too far...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I've even hurt Honami and the others by saying what I was feeling after getting really frustrated.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Shih...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Luckily, you succeeded this time.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah...
Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Len & Rin
rows.Line:
You're welcome.
You're welcome!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Sorry for keeping you.
Let's make the most of these training sessions.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, let's do just that!
